How to play Geography Chain

Cities, countries, rivers — last letter chains Classic geography game. Say a place name, the next player says a place starting with the last letter of yours. Can't repeat. Can't pause. Out you go.

2–8 players~10 minBrainy & CompetitiveMemory & chain games🚗 Works in the car

How to play

  1. First player says any place — city, country, river, landmark.
  2. Next player says a place beginning with the last letter of the previous one.
  3. No repeating places. No pausing more than 5 seconds.
  4. If you repeat or can't think of one, you're out.
  5. Last player in wins.

Example round

  • Paris → Seoul → London → Nairobi → Italy → Yemen → Norway...
  • Someone says 'Zimbabwe' to trap the next person on A.
  • 'Antarctica' ends in A — actually generous. 'Alaska' is the trap letter: A.

Tips

  • Letter traps: end on 'X', 'Q', 'U', or 'W' — very few places start with those.
  • Good starting arsenal for hard letters: Xian (X), Quebec (Q), Uruguay (U).
